title: Negative-input arms on the public draft JSON endpoints have no test (P2)
detail: grep of draft_integration_test.gleam confirms: no malformed-JSON->400 test for either endpoint, no invalid-email->400 test for /continue-link (only the /draft twin at line 130), no unknown-vacancy-code->404 test (the lookup_accepting_vacancy empty-row arm; only the closed-vacancy arm is pinned). The two handlers duplicate this validation rather than sharing it, so a regression in the continue-link copy compiles and ships silently. Public unauthenticated endpoints deserve the negative pin.
recommended_fix: Add three small integration tests mirroring save_draft_rejects_invalid_email_test: malformed JSON body -> 400 (both endpoints), invalid email -> 400 on /continue-link, unknown short_code -> 404 JSON on /draft.

title: Stage-2 reminder recipient-to-continue-url mapping glue is untested (both ends covered)
detail: The F3xE2 seam (briefing requirement 5) is covered at both ends — list_resumable_draft_tokens SQL filters (list_resumable_draft_tokens_filters_live_only_test) and build_reminder_stage2_html CTA swap (two unit tests) — but the join logic (lowercased dict lookup, empty-token guard, prefetch-failure degrade at line 822) has no test. Existing convention asserts only the synchronous handler response because background sends need a real Resend key, so the mapping ships unpinned.
recommended_fix: Extract the recipient->continue_url mapping into a pure function (rows + recipient email -> continue_url) and unit-test the hit / miss / empty-token / case-mismatch arms; leave the send closure as-is.

title: Continue-link send-success and send-failure handler paths covered only up to the SQL claim
detail: The claim-wins -> send -> ok:true path and the send-fails -> clear_last_link_sent -> ok:false 200 path are never exercised through handle_continue_link. Mitigations are real: claim/cooldown/clear SQL are integration-tested (claim_continue_link_send_mints_once_then_cools_down_test, clear_last_link_sent_re_arms_the_claim_test), the email HTML/subject are unit-tested, and the resend-confirmation precedent is established house convention. PARTIAL coverage, deliberately accepted.
recommended_fix: None required beyond the stated manual E2E; if automated coverage is ever wanted, inject the Resend base URL so a local stub can stand in for api.resend.com.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: save round-trip, filter_fields contract (5 unit tests), continue-link claim/cooldown/no-leak, resume restore + token scoping + uniform 404 + no-prefetch-stamp, erasure confirm/delete/replay + tombstone guard, strip-on-submit (SQL + W7 wired through handle_post_form), retention expiry sweep (closed/past-close expire; active/archived survive), vacancy cascade, CSRF skip, public-path arms, PostHog token scrub, 500-draft cap, 3/hour fan-out bound all pinned at the correct level. P1 ~95%: only the Resend send path (house precedent) and the stage-2 mapping glue are partial. Overall well above 80% — 27 integration + ~21 new unit tests; level mix matches convention (pure policy unit-tested, SQL/handlers integration-tested, JS serializer in scripts/js-tests outside this chunk).
recommended_fix: Land the three negative-input tests from the warning finding to push P2 arms toward full; consider the pure-function extraction for the stage-2 mapping.
